title: Efficacy and safety of antibody-drug conjugates in EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer after tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
caption: (A)  Forest plot of pooled ORR for the TROP2-targeting ADC subgroup (4 studies, n = 418). Pooled ORR = 50.6% (95% CI 40.3%–60.9%; I² = 73.8%).  (B)  Forest plot of pooled ORR for the HER3-targeting ADC subgroup (3 studies, n = 596). Pooled ORR = 34.2% (95% CI 28.8%–39.8%; I² = 45.7%).
context: (A)  Forest plot of pooled ORR for the TROP2-targeting ADC subgroup (4 studies, n = 418). Pooled ORR = 50.6% (95% CI 40.3%–60.9%; I² = 73.8%).  (B)  Forest plot of pooled ORR for the HER3-targeting ADC subgroup (3 studies, n = 596). Pooled ORR = 34.2% (95% CI 28.8%–39.8%; I² = 45.7%). The TROP2-subgroup forest plot is shown in Figure 3A . A dedicated HER3-subgroup forest plot is shown in Figure 3B .
